business_problem: Modern sports organizations rely on hundreds of technologies to capture athlete information, including wearable sensors, GPS tracking, medical systems, strength and conditioning platforms, video analytics, and IoT devices. Every system contributes valuable insights, but together they create enormous complexity, confusion, and fragmentation.
solution_summary: Working together, Devoteam and Kitman Labs engineers designed a state-of-the-art ELT pipeline using Datastream for semi real-time Change Data Capture (CDC) from their Ruby/React databases directly into BigQuery , utilizing Dataform for complex data transformations. A multi-tenant Looker Embed environment managed entirely through Infrastructure as Code (using a custom Looker Terraform provider developed by Devoteam) was created to align with Kitman Labs’ organizational needs. Behind the scenes, Google Cloud technologies work together to deliver near real-time intelligence at global scale. Datastream continuously captures operational data and streams it into BigQuery. Dataform organizes and transforms the data using a medallion architecture optimized for analytics. Looker provides embedded dashboards, semantic modeling, and self-service business intelligence directly within My iP.
